Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to various diseases and the aging process. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health and wellness benefits, including reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, lowering the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer, and promoting overall cellular health.
